text:
mira: quick heads-up from the orion-v1 int8 smoke. we see U+3000 (IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE) between han and latin being removed in int8 canary outputs, causing token join and ~0.8 BLEU drop on zh->en subtitle shard.

tao: repro'd locally. fp16 keeps \u3000, int8 output drops it and joins words. pre-token ids are identical. suspect postprocess again.

mira: repro snippet below (utf8 terminal):
```
echo -n "\u4e2d\u56fd\u3000hello" | ./infer --model orion-v1 --quant int8 --input -
# out-int8: \u4e2d\u56fdhello
# out-fp16: \u4e2d\u56fd\u3000hello
```

anya: which postproc/detok image is the int8 canary using?

sven: int8 canary manifest points to `postproc:2024-08-compat`. fp16 baseline used `postproc:main`. that compat tag has a compatibility path that normalizes ideographic spaces to ASCII space.

tao: ideographic space behaves differently for CJK layout; mapping to ASCII space changes width and token boundaries. downstream subtitle alignment breaks.

mira: bypassed postproc locally (raw join) and IDEO space preserved, BLEU back to baseline. confirms postproc.

anya: plan: (1) add unit test to postproc-compat to preserve U+3000 when adjacent to CJK; (2) temporarily point the int8 canary to postproc:main until compat fix lands; (3) add U+3000 sample to multilingual dev bundle and quant smoke.

sven: opened PR #814 on postproc-compat with a preserving change + test. CI kicked off.

eng-ci-bot: [CI] postproc-compat PR #814 started 

tao: extra follow-up: add a manifest lint in infra that ensures any quant canary uses a postproc image with known-preserve-spaces flag or tag >= main for locale-sensitive models. avoids pin drift.

mira: re-ran the int8 smoke after pointing to postproc:main  BLEU delta down to 0.03. good.

eng-ci-bot: [CI] postproc-compat PR #814 passed \u2014 10 tests :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks team. adding U+3000, figure-space and narrow no-break samples to the dev bundle and onboarding checklist. marking resolved for now. will re-open if other ideographic whitespace shows issues. :thumbsup:
